:::{#cor-se-rmse-unbiased}
#### For unbiased estimators, SE equals root MSE

If $\hth$ is [unbiased](#def-unbiased), then:

$$\SE{\hth} = \sqrt{\mselr{\hth}}$$

:::

::: proof

By @eq-unbiased-mse, $\mselr{\hth} = \Var{\hth}$.
Taking square roots of both sides,
$\sqrt{\mselr{\hth}} = \SD{\hth} = \SE{\hth}$.

:::
